newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads - Stable to U.S. pre-FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads - Stable to U.S. pre-FOMC.

text.p: Australian bond yield spreads to the U.S. were little changed as the market awaited the outcome to the Federal Open Committee meeting on Tuesday.

The local market weakened much in line with the sell-off in U.S. Treasuries on Friday following stronger than expected housing data and amid uncertainty ahead of the policy making meeting over whether it tightens policy.

"We expect the Aussie-U.S. 10-year spread to continue in a 95-110 basis point range. The extent of a rally in the U.S. on an unchanged Fed policy is limited since the Fed will maintain a tightening bias," said Glen Maguire, economist at Societe Generale Australia.
The local market slightly underperformed against Canada based on levels in a shortened session there on Friday ahead of today's Victoria Day holiday.
However, spreads narrowed to New Zealand, which were weighed down by the short-end on the continuation of an easing N.Z. TWI.
